title: Feature request
body:
The app is good and simple, but if possible, can you include “end time” as the task is created with 30 minutes only. Also it will be great to be able to set alarm before the task (like 30 or 60 minutes alarm before task)

I know this can be done from google calendar, but since tasks integrate with calendar, this will be a great feature.

Thank you
